Standard unrooted Android isolates camera hardware via Camera HAL and SELinux. Third-party apps (WhatsApp, Instagram, Meet) access cameras directly via CameraManager and system HAL.

Without root, Xposed, or custom OS firmware, injecting fake video directly into other apps' private Camera2 sessions is prevented by Android OS security.

This app provides:
1. Real-time Physical Camera preview (CameraX)
2. Virtual Video Feed preview with smooth hardware-accelerated playback and full transport controls (Play, Pause, Stop, Loop, Mute, Seek)
3. System Camera Intent capture responder (responds to camera capture intents from other apps)
4. Floating overlay mode for multitasking.
